hero.headline: A passionate Software Engineer specializing in building exceptional digital experiences. I create scalable web applications and cloud solutions that make a difference.

introduction: I'm a passionate Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience building scalable web applications and cloud solutions. I specialize in full-stack development using modern technologies like React, Node.js, and cloud platforms.

My journey in tech started with a curiosity for how things work, which evolved into a deep passion for creating elegant solutions to complex problems. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and continuously learning new technologies.
about.career_objective: To leverage my technical expertise and problem-solving skills in a challenging role where I can contribute to innovative projects that make a meaningful impact. I'm seeking opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies while continuing to grow as a software engineer.
